description.value: Defensive ability listed in the source statblock: Channel Resistance +5.
Due to having an oversized claw and being extremely shape, the tomb's claw is considered two size categories larger and its critical tier is increased to x3.

Once every 1d4+1 rounds, a Tomb can breath out a dry gray breath hitting all those within a 30-ft. cone. The targets within the area of effect receive the Statue status effect (Fortitude save DC 21 to negate). Blue mages may learn this ability as a 7th level spell (Knowledge: Religion DC 29).

effect: Once every 1d4+1 rounds, a Tomb can breath out a dry gray breath hitting all those within a 30-ft. cone. The targets within the area of effect receive the Statue status effect (Fortitude save DC 21 to negate). Blue mages may learn this ability as a 7th level spell (Knowledge: Religion DC 29).

description.value: Whenever a Tomb strikes its opponent with its claw, they must make a save for every status ailment inflicted upon them. The following status effects are Blind (Fortitude save 22), Confuse (Will save 22), Sap (Fortitude save 22), Sleep (Will save 22), and Slow (Fortitude save 22) for 1d4 rounds.

effect: On claw hit roll all five saves separately; effects last [[1d4]] rounds.
